summary: Inogen filed an 8-K disclosing a September 29, 2026 Asset Purchase Agreement to sell substantially all assets of its U.S. oxygen rental business to Rotech Healthcare. The price is estimated at up to ~$24.8 million based on transferred inventory and patient records, subject to post-closing reconciliation, payable in six installments. The board also approved a conditional amendment to Inogen's existing $30M buyback, raising total authorization to $45M and extending expiry to June 30, 2028, effective only on deal closing. Closing is subject to customary conditions; no advisor named.
